{{Quote|Ah. The Junkers. Junkers. Strange folk.|[[Morley/Legends|Morley]]|<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Junkers''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived on the junk [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]]. They inhabited the planet Lotho Minor for centuries, and were armed with usually a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] or anything that was "salvageable."

==Biology and appearance==
Junkers appeared to be a strange [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] of organic life and mechanical debris. They augmented their strange and twisted bodies with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic enhancements]].<ref name=":0">{{SWE|groups|junkers|Junkers}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
Mysterious denizens,<ref name="SWE-Lotho Minor">{{SWE|locations|lothominor|Lotho Minor}}</ref> Junkers were wandering scavengers clad in metal.<ref name=":1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Somehow surviving on their [[Lotho Minor/Legends|garbage dump world]],<ref name="SWE-fire-breather">{{SWE|technology|firebreather|fire-breather}}</ref> they lived off the scrap found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]'s surface.<ref name=":0" /> They were fiercely territorial,<ref name="SW-Brothers - The Clone Wars Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep421|text="Brothers" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> attacking whoever entered their domain.<ref name="Brothers" />

==History==
No one was quite sure of the origins of the mysterious natives of [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]], as the planet's role as a galactic dumping ground didn't encourage any deep exploration of Junker culture or biology, nor has their violent territoriality.<ref name=":0" /> The origin of these bizarre nomads was one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s many mysteries.<ref name=":1" /> They had lived on [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]] for so long that it was impossible to tell where their bodies ended and where the refuse began.<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Savage_VS_Junkers.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] fights the herd of Junkers on Lotho Minor, while searching for his [[Darth Maul/Legends|brother]].]]In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="FF-2014 24: Maul">{{FactFile2014|24|MAU 1-2|Darth Maul's Cybernetic Legs}}</ref> a tribe of Junkers ambushed [[Morley/Legends|Morley]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], but failed after Savage and Morley defeated them and forced the remaining to retreat. There were also dead Junkers hung in [[Darth Maul's lair]].<ref name="Brothers" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] beings known as "junkers" were present on an artificial [[Ship graveyard]] [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] attempting to salvage the damaged [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Reverie]]''.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear">''[[Star Wars Adventures: Boba Fett and the Ship of Fear]]''</ref>
